lines.text: The root is Form! Transform, uniform.
Did you know? Form is Latin for shape.
Quick quiz! Which means one plus shape?

words.ex: The old factory was transformed into an art centre.
Students must wear a uniform at this school.

publish.title: Form root: transform and uniform
publish.value: Form comes from Latin "forma" (shape, form). Words: transform and uniform. transform = trans + form; uniform = uni + form.
